The '''Ilum Talisman''' was a teardrop-shaped piece of stone that radiated [[Force power/Legends|power]] to nearby [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]]. The Talisman was formerly owned by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Val Isa/Legends|Val Isa]]. It could be worn as a necklace, and contained veins of crystal that were visible when the Talisman was held to the light.<ref name="FDCR" />
